theorem lg_target {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ K] (k : Subfield K) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥k) K := by
  let S := k
  let L := ↥S
  have h : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ L := IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_tower_bot K S
  exact IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_tower_top K S h
